$comment: CANONICAL ADDRESS REGISTRY — the one place every Tegridy address is written down in full.
WHY THIS EXISTS. On 2026-08-08 an operator wallet holding 0.496 SOL nearly could not be found,
because it had only ever been recorded in a session note as a TRUNCATED string ('5hNA2MXk…927v').
Worse, a later session INVENTED a full address to fit that truncation — 45 characters decoding to
33 bytes, not a valid Solana pubkey at all. Had anyone funded it, the money would have been gone.
THE RULES THIS FILE ENFORCES (see verify-addresses.mjs, which fails CI on each):
1. Addresses are stored in FULL. Never a '…', never a '0x1234…abcd' shorthand.
2. Every address is structurally validated — EVM to EIP-55 checksum, Solana to exactly 32 bytes.
3. Nothing in this file may collide with the denylist below.
4. Every non-zero address in src/lib/constants.ts must appear here, so a new deploy cannot
enter the codebase without being registered and explained.
WHAT MUST NEVER GO IN THIS FILE: private keys, seed phrases, or the FILESYSTEM PATHS of keyfiles.
This repository is PUBLIC. Key custody is tracked in an operator-local file that is not committed;
the 'custody' field here says WHO controls a key, never WHERE it is stored.
